tools.name: search_rackets
tools.description: Searches published padel-racket records by model or brand words, exact year, shape, explicit budget currency and calculated playing characteristics. Returns a bounded list, applied ranking rule, missing inputs, dated source prices and canonical PadelTrue model URLs. All query words must match. A pri

tools.name: get_racket
tools.description: Retrieves one exact padel-racket record by catalogue slug. Returns source-linked specifications, dated source price, calculated ratings, missing inputs, source conflicts and the canonical PadelTrue product URL. Ratings are estimates rather than play tests. tools.name: compare_rackets
tools.description: Compares two exact catalogue slugs. Returns published specifications, calculated rating differences, same-currency source-price observations, missing inputs and the canonical PadelTrue comparison URL. Catalogue-price differences are arithmetic comparisons of dated observations, not verified current

tools.name: search
tools.description: Finds PadelTrue catalogue documents by literal brand, model, year or shape keywords. Every keyword must match. Returns document IDs, titles and canonical product URLs for retrieval with fetch. Budget and playing-characteristic filters are available in search_rackets. Empty results describe this cata

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieves one public PadelTrue catalogue document by the ID returned by search. Returns a canonical citation URL, source-linked specifications, dated source price, calculated ratings, missing inputs and source conflicts. Ratings are calculated estimates, not play tests; price observations do not ver

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
